nodes.description: ICongressMembersRegistry membersRegistry; used by onlyMember modifier and quorum checks.
uint public proposalCount; incremented in propose.
mapping(uint => Proposal) public proposals; storage of all proposals and receipts.
string public constant name = 'TokensFarmCongress'.
external setMembersRegistry(address) that initializes membersRegistry once.
modifier onlyMember; access gate calling membersRegistry.isMember(msg.sender).
external propose(...) creating a new Proposal and storing it in proposals.
external castVote(uint,bool) delegating to _castVote with msg.sender.
internal _castVote(address,uint,bool) recording a receipt and tallying votes.
external payable execute(uint) looping over proposal targets and performing arbitrary low-level calls.
external cancel(uint) canceling a proposal after a 3-day timelock and below quorum.
external view getActions(uint) returning proposal targets, values, signatures, calldatas.
external view getMembersRegistry() returning the members registry address.
internal pure add256(uint,uint) performing checked addition.
receive() external payable emitting ReceivedEther.
msg.sender; used for membership checks, proposer and receive event.
block.timestamp; stored in proposals and used for the cancel timelock.
proposal.targets[i].call{value:proposal.values[i]}(callData); arbitrary external call with value.
proposal.executed = true is set before the external call loop, enabling reentrancy vectors.
uint c = a + b inside add256; checked addition guarding overflow.
require(block.timestamp >= proposal.timestamp + 259200) timelock comparison in cancel.
address _membersRegistry parameter of setMembersRegistry.
address[] targets parameter of propose.
uint[] values parameter of propose.
string[] signatures parameter of propose.
bytes[] calldatas parameter of propose.
string description parameter of propose.
uint proposalId parameter of castVote.
bool support parameter of castVote.
address voter parameter of _castVote.
uint proposalId parameter of _castVote.
bool support parameter of _castVote.
uint proposalId parameter of execute.
uint proposalId parameter of cancel.
uint proposalId parameter of getActions.
uint256 a parameter of add256.
uint256 b parameter of add256.
Proposal memory newProposal built and stored in propose.
Proposal storage proposal loaded in execute.
bytes memory callData assembled from signature and calldata in execute.
bool success returned by the low-level call in execute.
uint i loop counter in execute.
Proposal storage proposal loaded in cancel.
Proposal storage proposal loaded in _castVote.
Receipt storage receipt of the voter in _castVote.
uint c holding a + b in add256.

edges.reason: onlyMember modifier gates propose with membersRegistry.isMember(msg.sender).
onlyMember modifier gates castVote.
onlyMember modifier gates execute; member-only execution of arbitrary calls.
onlyMember modifier gates cancel.
msg.sender is passed to membersRegistry.isMember inside onlyMember.
msg.sender stored as proposal proposer in propose.
msg.sender forwarded as voter to _castVote.
msg.sender emitted in ReceivedEther event in receive.
block.timestamp stored as proposal.timestamp when proposing.
block.timestamp drives the cancel timelock requirement (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp compared against proposal.timestamp + 259200.
_membersRegistry parameter is cast and assigned to membersRegistry.
setMembersRegistry writes the membersRegistry state variable that controls membership.
onlyMember reads membersRegistry to authorize callers.
targets array flows into the created proposal.
values array flows into the created proposal.
signatures array flows into the created proposal.
calldatas array flows into the created proposal.
description is emitted with ProposalCreated.
newProposal local struct is assembled inside propose.
proposalCount++ increments the global counter.
proposals[newProposal.id] = newProposal writes persistent storage.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal to vote on.
support parameter is forwarded to _castVote.
castVote delegates to internal _castVote.
voter address keys the receipts mapping in _castVote.
proposalId selects the proposal in _castVote.
support decides which vote tally is incremented.
_castVote reads and mutates proposals storage (receipts/forVotes/againstVotes).
proposal storage reference is loaded in _castVote.
receipt storage reference is loaded for the voter in _castVote.
_castVote calls add256 to tally forVotes/againstVotes.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal to execute.
execute loads Proposal storage from proposals and rewrites executed flag.
proposal storage pointer is loaded in execute.
execute sets proposal.executed = true before making external calls.
execute performs arbitrary low-level calls to proposal.targets with value.
executed flag of the loaded proposal is mutated.
State is committed before the external call, the classic reentrancy ordering.
callData is derived from the proposal signature and calldatas.
callData built from proposal data is passed to the untrusted low-level call.
loop counter i indexes targets/values/signatures/calldatas of the external call.
execute loop iterates over proposal.targets using i.
success bool from the low-level call is required to be true.
The external call transfers control to an untrusted target that can re-enter execute or castVote.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal to cancel.
cancel loads and mutates the proposals mapping (canceled flag).
proposal storage pointer is loaded in cancel.
cancel enforces the 3-day timelock using block.timestamp.
cancel reads membersRegistry.getMinimalQuorum for the quorum requirement.
execute reads membersRegistry.getMinimalQuorum before performing calls.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal returned by getActions.
getActions reads targets/values/signatures/calldatas from proposals.
getMembersRegistry returns the membersRegistry address.
parameter a is the first addend in add256.
parameter b is the second addend in add256.
a participates in the checked addition a + b.
b participates in the checked addition a + b.
add256 performs the uint addition that may overflow.
local c holds the result of a + b.
